findings: Unscannable summary writer stores groupType SUMMARY_UNSCANNABLE, but reader queries UNSCANNABLE_SUMMARY. The normal-group query excludes only the latter value, so the written summary is treated as an unknown normal-group entry and skipped; unreadable paths are not restored. Source-only, SQL reproduction pending.

Group primary key is uniqueId alone, without scope. A scoped group with the same signature as a retained FULL group replaces it, with foreign-key cascade deleting prior member refs. This contradicts independent FULL/SCOPED persistence; actual Room transaction behavior not run.
Summary uniqueId is likewise a single global UNSCANNABLE_SUMMARY across scopes. Scoped summary insertion replaces the full-scan summary.
save/load/clear operations have Room @Transaction annotations, improving atomicity within those DAO operations. This does not correct key collisions or validate file content.

loadLatestScanResults prioritizes any stored scoped data before full data. Repository-level validation happens after this choice, so invalid scoped groups can prevent fallback to otherwise valid full groups.

Media refs have autogenerated IDs and groupId index without a uniqueness constraint on group/item. Read query has no ORDER BY; restored member order is not explicitly guaranteed. Hash/pHash fields are force-unwrapped on conversion.

Database declares version 3 with explicit 1->2 scope-column and 2->3 denial-table migrations. Tracked schema versions include a later 5.json; consistency with current declarations and DI migration setup remains to inspect.
